        Reading this page

        How exact is the location?

        The point marks the place named in the report, not an exact impact point. The details say whether that is a facility, a city, an area or a sea area.

        What does claimed mean?

        The event was reported by only one side and not confirmed by anyone else. Claimed events say so at the top of their page.

        Where do the prices and odds come from?

        Brent and WTI are daily spot prices from the U.S. Energy Information Administration. The odds are Polymarket prices on questions related to the event, each with its own date.
